concreteMixes.grade: Mix ratios are indicative planning figures (typical Egyptian practice for normal-weight structural concrete) — the actual mix design must be confirmed by an approved trial mix / laboratory report for the specific project, cement type and target slump. Batching/Mixing/Pumping (col J) and Admixture allowance (col I, linked to ADM-01) are editable per project/plant arrangement.

contingency.basis: Repetitive, well-defined scope, firm BOQ, familiar site — e.g. standard buildings, minor resurfacing
Some design/ground uncertainty, moderate site risk — e.g. new roads, standard bridges
Significant uncertainty, difficult ground/logistics — e.g. complex bridges, large/urban infrastructure
Major unknowns, specialized/first-of-kind works — e.g. tunnels, deep foundations, marine works

escalation.note: Assumes even cost incidence over duration (avg. 50% exposure). Replace with the contract's own index-linked price-adjustment formula (e.g. FIDIC/local Pn=Po(a+b·Mn/Mo+c·Ln/Lo)) if one is stipulated.

buildings.notes: Price as % of civil cost or detailed sub-BOQ
